content: Direct data provision : The PduRDestPduDat- aProvision of the destination I-PDU is configured to PDUR_DIRECT . When <DstLo>_Transmit is called the <DstLo> module copies the data and the PDU Router does not buffer the transmitted I-PDU any longer.
